claims.text: South Oregon Street & 35th Avenue South had 0 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 people killed.

No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations (too few crashes to test).

The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: passed the causal gate (pedestrian injury crashes changed -33% (95% interval -52% to -13%) at 371 sites against sites treated later or the citywide trend, and a placebo date shows nothing); a second run of the same design on 366 sites agrees.
The Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT) is responsible for Rainier Avenue South, South Genesee Street, South Oregon Street (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
